mailbox_quota.title: Mailbox quota
mailbox_quota.plain_language: The amount of mailbox storage assigned and currently consumed.
recommended_actions: Review large mailboxes and retention needs
Enable quota alerts and archive appropriate content

mailbox_capacity.title: Mailbox capacity
mailbox_capacity.plain_language: The maximum volume a mailbox can hold, including recoverable and deleted items.
recommended_actions: Apply retention and archive policies deliberately

email_activity.title: Email activity
email_activity.plain_language: Measures sending and receiving activity over a selected period.
recommended_actions: Investigate unusual volume through audit data

shared_mailbox.title: Shared mailbox
shared_mailbox.plain_language: A mailbox used by multiple people rather than one named user.
recommended_actions: Assign a business owner and review members
Use least privilege and monitor usage

distribution_group.title: Distribution group
distribution_group.plain_language: An email address that delivers messages to a defined group of recipients.

mail_flow.title: Mail flow
mail_flow.plain_language: The transport rules and connectors that route and protect messages.
recommended_actions: Review transport rules and connector scope
Monitor message trace and outbound forwarding
